name: dsh-plugin-chatgroup
description: Group chat plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): one human + up to five AI members discussing project requirements in rounds.

scripts.build:client: tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && esbuild src/client/index.ts --bundle --format=cjs --platform=browser --target=es2022 --jsx=transform --jsx-factory=createElement --jsx-fragment=Fragment --external:react --external:react/jsx-runtime --external:react-dom --external:@deepseek-ai/cordis --external:@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots --external:@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime/client --outfile=dist/client.js --banner:js='window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: "dsh-plugin-chatgroup", factory: (require) => { var module = { exports: {} }; var exports = module.exports;' --footer:js='return module.exports; } });'
scripts.build: npm run build:host && npm run build:client
